slots.name: arr.bridge
slots.receives: Five categories: the planned net new ARR (named with the plan label), the gap in new business, in expansion and reactivation, and in churn and contraction (positive when losses were lower than planned), then actual net new ARR. Bars in $ millions; the plan bar is grey. Each bar's amount is written in bold above it; a thin line crosses each gap from the edge of one bar to the edge of the next, at the level where one ends and the next begins; value axis in $ millions with gridlines.
